risk_summary: The disclosure presents meaningful credit, economic, real estate, unemployment, and interest-rate risks, but also reports improving real estate values and lower nonperforming assets. Risk discussion is partly boilerplate and relies on scenario-based qualifiers, although the allowance methodology, valuation thresholds, and historical rate/volume impacts are described with useful specificity.
